title: Past Life Debt
subtitle: Nakshatra Rnanubandhan
description: The nakshatra the Moon sits in is the karmic address of the soul. Based on classical Vedic texts where Lord Shiva explains to Mata Parvati why a soul takes birth in a specific nakshatra.

Ashwini.pastKarma: The soul worked as a healer or caretaker but failed in duty — gave wrong treatment for gain, refused help to those in need, or was cruel to animals.
Ashwini.currentLife: Restless energy, fast instinct, natural healing power, constant rush. Mind cannot sit still, ideas fire rapidly.
remedy: Serve horse with grain and water
Donate medicine to the poor
Feed stray dog on Saturday
Help accident victims
Chant Ashwini Kumar mantra or Gayatri 108 times daily for 41 days
Ashwini.onceCleared: The restlessness becomes a real pioneering force.

Bharani.pastKarma: The soul caused harm to women — caused abortion knowingly, mistreated wife, or broke promise made to a young woman.
Bharani.currentLife: Deep emotional weight, intense passion, hidden burden, strong sense of right and wrong, recurring drama in love.
remedy: Feed nine unmarried girls with sweet rice on Tuesday
Donate red cloth and sindoor to widows
Support orphanage of girl children
Fast on Friday with vow of silence
Chant Yama Sukta or Durga Saptashloki for 41 days
Bharani.onceCleared: The soul becomes a powerful creative force capable of giving birth to art and ideas that change lives.

Krittika.pastKarma: The soul disrespected fire ritual, mocked a brahmin, harmed an innocent priest, or misused a position of authority granted by an elder.
Krittika.currentLife: Sharp tongue, fiery temper, leadership pull, perfectionist eye, deep loyalty to family, but sudden self-created enemies.
remedy: Feed brahmin or saintly people on full moon
Perform daily simple havan with mango wood and ghee
Donate yellow items and copper
Help vedic students with study fees
Chant Agni Sukta or Aditya Hridaya 108 times daily
Krittika.onceCleared: The same fire becomes a healing flame that protects family and refines work to art.

Rohini.pastKarma: The soul enjoyed wealth and beauty but cheated a cow, stole milk meant for sacred ritual, or was selfish with food while servants went hungry.
Rohini.currentLife: Magnetic beauty, soft skin, deep voice, attraction towards luxury, art, food, music, and pleasure. Creative, sensual, slow but deep.
remedy: Serve cow daily before sunrise with green grass and rice
Donate white sweet, milk and rice on Monday
Feed students with study material
Chant Krishna mantra or Lakshmi Sukta for 41 days
Rohini.onceCleared: Beauty and wealth flow without hidden emptiness, and the soul becomes a creator of lasting art.

Mrigashirsha.pastKarma: The soul was a hunter or noble who killed innocent deer for sport instead of survival, sometimes even hunting pregnant or young animals.
Mrigashirsha.currentLife: Restless seeker energy, gentle eye, soft voice, deep sensitivity, constant search for meaning, and deep love for travel. Never satisfied with current situation.
remedy: Plant trees especially neem and peepal
Donate to wildlife trust
Feed deer in sanctuary
Donate green cloth and copper
Chant Soma mantra or Chandra Stotra during waxing moon for 41 days
Mrigashirsha.onceCleared: The search inside transforms from restlessness into real wisdom and the seeker becomes the finder.

Ardra.pastKarma: The soul caused unnecessary destruction — killed birds, broke shelter of homeless, harmed nature, or used words to break someone's life.
Ardra.currentLife: Intense storm of emotion, sharp intellect, sudden tears and joy, often early childhood loss, tendency to question everything. Investigative, revolutionary mind.
remedy: Donate blanket and shelter material to homeless on Saturday
Feed stray dog and crow daily
Help flood and storm victims
Light black sesame oil lamp at Shiva temple on Monday and Saturday
Chant Rudri or Maha Mrityunjaya for 1.25 lakh count
Ardra.onceCleared: The storm inside becomes a creative thunder that brings transformation to the world.

Punarvasu.pastKarma: The soul broke promise to a teacher, mocked saintly people, abandoned spiritual practice mid-journey, or quit a divine path for material gain.
Punarvasu.currentLife: Restart energy — many small lives within one life. Wisdom is natural, optimism constant even after failure, rebound power unmatched.
remedy: Serve guru and teacher with food and gift
Support students of religious study
Donate yellow lentil and saffron on Thursday
Light ghee lamp at Vishnu temple
Chant Guru mantra Om Gram Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah for 18000 count or 16 rounds of Hare Krishna mahamantra daily
Punarvasu.onceCleared: The restart energy turns into mature renewal that builds long-lasting structure in life.

Pushya.pastKarma: The soul dishonored elderly, abandoned parent in old age, refused to feed an elder family member, or mocked the wisdom of a senior.
Pushya.currentLife: Caretaker energy — the responsible one in every group, the natural protector. Steady, dependable, devotional, slow to anger but firm in principle.
remedy: Serve parent and elder daily with own hand
Feed old age home residents on Saturday
Donate yellow cloth and sweet on Thursday
Support widows and orphans
Chant Brihaspati mantra Om Brim Brihaspataye Namah for 19000 count or Vishnu Sahasranama daily
Pushya.onceCleared: This nakshatra becomes a money magnet protected by divine grace for the entire family line.

Ashlesha.pastKarma: The soul killed a snake without reason, used dark practices against innocent people, tried to harm through poison, or worshipped Naga deity for selfish destructive purpose.
Ashlesha.currentLife: Sharp intuition, hypnotic eye, mystical attraction, deep psychological insight, secret nature. But also overthinking, trust issues, and hidden anxiety.
remedy: Perform Naga puja on Naga Panchami
Offer raw milk near a snake hole or Shiva temple
Feed the poor on Amavasya
Donate black sesame and silver
Do Sarpa Sukta path
Chant Subramanya mantra Om Saravana Bhava or Nag Gayatri for 41 days
Ashlesha.onceCleared: The hidden power becomes healing power that protects family from invisible harm.

Magha.pastKarma: The soul dishonored ancestors — refused to perform shraddha and tarpan, insulted family lineage, or destroyed family wealth out of pride.
Magha.currentLife: Strong pitra dosh signature, royal bearing, lion energy, family pride, deep loyalty to lineage. But also unexplained delays in marriage, childbirth, or career start.
remedy: Perform shraddha for ancestors every Amavasya
Feed crow and brahmin during Pitru Paksha
Donate black sesame, white cloth, water and food to elderly
Visit ancestor temple in birth village
Chant Pitru Stotra and Pitru Gayatri for 41 days
Magha.onceCleared: The lion energy of Magha rises and brings real authority that benefits the entire family.

Purva Phalguni.pastKarma: The soul was selfish in love — used relationships purely for pleasure, deceived a partner who trusted deeply, or destroyed someone's family for own gain.
Purva Phalguni.currentLife: Warm charm, romantic energy, artistic taste, magnetic personality, love for celebration. But also relationship turbulence, broken first love, and hidden creative dissatisfaction.
remedy: Serve newly married couples with food and gift
Donate sweet, white flower, sugar and silver to Lakshmi temple
Feed cow with sugarcane on Friday
Help single women find dignity
Chant Lakshmi Ashtottara or Sri Sukta for 41 days
Purva Phalguni.onceCleared: Love stabilises, and creative power flows without inner drama.

Uttara Phalguni.pastKarma: The soul broke trust of a friend, betrayed a close ally, cheated a business partner, or made a false agreement that ruined someone's life.
Uttara Phalguni.currentLife: Leadership ability, social charm, organising skill, pure heart, dependable nature. But also recurring betrayal from trusted people, frequent change of business partner, and slow marriage.
remedy: Help a friend in true need without expectation of return
Donate wheat and jaggery to brahmin on Sunday
Feed cow daily before lunch
Donate to charity in someone else's name
Support marriage of poor girl
Chant Aditya Hridaya or Surya Ashtottara at sunrise for 41 days
Uttara Phalguni.onceCleared: True friendship returns and partnership becomes a long-lasting source of wealth and respect.

Hasta.pastKarma: The soul used hands for theft, fraud, manipulation, forging documents, or unfair labour against helpless workers.
Hasta.currentLife: Skilful hand, craft talent, healing touch, sharp practical intelligence, quick humour, fast learning. But also recurring small money loss, slipping opportunities at the last moment.
remedy: Serve people with own hand
Do seva at temple by cleaning
Donate handmade sweet and flower
Feed craftsmen and labourers on Wednesday
Donate green items and copper
Chant Surya mantra Om Hram Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah at sunrise for 7000 count or 41 days
Hasta.onceCleared: The same hand starts attracting wealth that stays.

Chitra.pastKarma: The soul was vain about own beauty, used appearance to manipulate, or destroyed the work of a fellow artist out of jealousy and ego.
Chitra.currentLife: Magnetic look, artistic eye, design talent, charismatic style, attention to detail. But also ego clash with peers, constant comparison, and hidden insecurity beneath the polish.
remedy: Do humble seva at temple
Donate colourful cloth and decorative items to deity
Help struggling artists financially
Light lamp on Tuesday at Hanuman temple
Feed red ant with sugar
Chant Hanuman Chalisa daily and Vishvakarma Stuti on his festival day
Chitra.onceCleared: The artistic gift brings real fame without inner emptiness.

Swati.pastKarma: The soul harmed others through gossip, gave false witness in court, spread rumour that ruined reputation, or used clever speech to manipulate weak people.
Swati.currentLife: Independent spirit, free thinking, business mind, sharp speech, balanced judgment. But also restlessness, sudden conflict over small words, and difficulty standing on one ground for long.
remedy: Practice silence one day a week
Donate clothing and shoes to poor on Saturday
Feed bird on rooftop daily
Donate book and pen to students
Light lamp at Saraswati temple
Chant Saraswati mantra Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah for 23000 count or one mandala
Swati.onceCleared: Speech becomes a source of fame instead of source of trouble.

Vishakha.pastKarma: The soul broke commitment in business, cheated a partner in deal, made a false promise that destroyed trust, or pretended to be a devotee while plotting selfish plans.
Vishakha.currentLife: Intense ambition, goal-driven energy, leadership pull, ability to win against impossible odds, devotional heart. But also frequent obstacles just before reaching the final goal, and dual nature.
remedy: Keep every promise made, even small ones
Donate yellow items and copper
Feed brahmin and saintly people on Thursday
Light ghee lamp at Vishnu temple
Support honest leaders and ethical movements
Chant Vishnu Sahasranama or Brihaspati mantra for 41 days
Vishakha.onceCleared: Big victory comes faster and stays longer.

Anuradha.pastKarma: The soul broke friendship for personal gain, betrayed group trust, led people astray with charm, or misused position of priest in past birth.
Anuradha.currentLife: Deep loyalty to close circle, foreign connection, group leadership talent, devotion to spiritual practice. But also sudden separation from people once close, and recurring shock from trusted persons.
remedy: Serve groups of needy people together
Donate black sesame and mustard oil on Saturday
Feed labourers and security guards
Do collective bhajan or kirtan
Visit Shani or Hanuman temple every Saturday
Chant Shani mantra Om Pram Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah for 23000 count or one mandala
Anuradha.onceCleared: Group-based work becomes a powerful source of fame and wealth.

Jyeshtha.pastKarma: The soul was proud, harmed elder sibling out of jealousy, dethroned someone unfairly through plot, misused authority granted by guru, or insulted a senior in a spiritual circle.
Jyeshtha.currentLife: Deep responsibility from young age, eldest sibling energy, secret personality, sharp intelligence, ability to handle crisis. But also sudden loss of position, betrayal at peak, and chronic family burden.
remedy: Serve elder sibling with respect even when unfairly treated
Donate to senior citizen home
Help retired military or police
Feed crow and dog daily
Light lamp at Hanuman temple on Tuesday and Saturday
Chant Hanuman Chalisa 11 times daily or Indra mantra for 41 days
Jyeshtha.onceCleared: Real authority arrives without hidden cost and bitterness transforms into spiritual depth.

Mula.pastKarma: The soul destroyed root of plant for selfish use, cut sacred peepal or banyan tree, harmed temple property, or poisoned a water body.
Mula.currentLife: Truth-seeking energy, philosophical mind, healer ability, foreign settlement signature. But also early life turbulence, parent separation, financial crash in childhood, sudden uprooting.
remedy: Plant tree especially peepal and banyan
Donate root vegetables to brahmin
Feed stray dog daily
Perform Mula shanti puja within 27 days of birth or on next Mula nakshatra day
Chant Ganesha mantra Om Gam Ganapataye Namah for 11000 count and Ketu mantra for 17000 count
Mula.onceCleared: The soul becomes a deeply spiritual teacher, powerfully grounded, and a source of healing for many.

Purva Ashadha.pastKarma: The soul misused power given by community, polluted a public water source, refused water to a thirsty traveller, or harmed people through arrogance and verbal attack.
Purva Ashadha.currentLife: Charisma, debating skill, philosophical mind, magnetic personality, victory over enemies, public speaking talent. But also overconfidence, pride that blocks higher growth, and pattern of spoiling own wins.
remedy: Donate water pot to poor in summer
Feed fish and aquatic life with grain
Plant trees near water body
Donate white cloth and silver
Help flood victims
Chant Vishnu Sahasranama or Varuna Sukta for 41 days
Purva Ashadha.onceCleared: The natural confidence becomes true wisdom respected by the entire community.

Uttara Ashadha.pastKarma: The soul left important duty incomplete, abandoned responsibility given by an elder, quit a divine path before reaching the goal, or refused to teach knowledge that was meant to be shared.
Uttara Ashadha.currentLife: Steady determination, slow rise, late but lasting victory, ethical mindset, leadership capability, deep loyalty to truth. But also a pattern of starting strong and slowing before completion.
remedy: Finish every project once started no matter the difficulty
Donate wheat and jaggery on Sunday
Feed cow and brahmin together on Sunday morning
Light lamp at Sun temple at sunrise
Help retired teachers and unfunded scholars
Chant Aditya Hridaya 3 times daily for one mandala
Uttara Ashadha.onceCleared: Slow steady work brings permanent legacy that outlives the body.

Shravana.pastKarma: The soul listened to wrong counsel and acted on it, spread harmful gossip after hearing private secrets, used inside information to harm someone's career, or refused to listen to scripture when offered by saintly people.
Shravana.currentLife: Sharp listening ability, learning power, language talent, deep devotion towards Vishnu, gentle voice. But also recurring sensitivity to noise, sudden imbalance in hearing, and emotional drain from absorbing others' stories.
remedy: Listen to Vishnu Sahasranama daily without distraction
Donate white sweet and rice on Wednesday and Thursday
Feed poor brahmin
Help students with study material
Support religious lecture series
Chant Om Namo Narayanaya for 12500 count or one mandala
Shravana.onceCleared: The listening skill becomes a source of deep wisdom and stable income.

Dhanishta.pastKarma: The soul was proud of wealth, ignored the poor at the doorstep, hoarded resources while others suffered, or used wealth to humiliate weaker people.
Dhanishta.currentLife: Musical talent, rhythm sense, leadership pull, real estate luck, group leadership ability, big dreams, generosity once trust is built. But also marriage delay, emotional coldness, and sudden financial swings.
remedy: Donate to musicians and street performers
Feed poor on Tuesday
Support orphans and widows
Donate red items and copper
Help in temple drum and shankh seva
Chant Hanuman Chalisa 7 times daily and Mars mantra Om Ang Angarkaya Namah for 7000 count
Dhanishta.onceCleared: Wealth comes with emotional warmth this time.

Shatabhisha.pastKarma: The soul harmed people through wrong medicine, false healing, broke trust as a doctor or healer, or hid cures for selfish profit.
Shatabhisha.currentLife: Mysterious personality, healing intuition, research mind, secret nature, interest in occult and alternative medicine. But also addiction risk, chronic small health issues, and tendency to isolate from crowd.
health: Chronic disease that doctors cannot easily diagnose
remedy: Serve sick people in hospital with own hand
Donate medicine to poor
Help recovery centres and addiction centres
Feed stray dog and crow daily
Perform Maha Mrityunjaya jaap 10000 times
Light lamp at Shiva temple on Monday for 41 days
Shatabhisha.onceCleared: Healing power becomes a natural gift that protects the entire family.

Purva Bhadrapada.pastKarma: The soul created fear in others through power, harmed people through tantra and dark practice, used spiritual energy for selfish destructive gain, or scared innocent people for control.
Purva Bhadrapada.currentLife: Intense seeker energy, dual personality between worldly and spiritual, sharp intellect, deep philosophical mind, foreign settlement signature. But also unusual fear, anxiety attacks, sleepless nights.
remedy: Perform Rudra abhishek every Monday for one year
Donate black sesame and oil
Feed cow and crow
Help fearful people find safety and shelter
Chant Maha Mrityunjaya 108 times daily and do Rudram path for one mandala
Purva Bhadrapada.onceCleared: Spiritual power returns in pure form that blesses others.

Uttara Bhadrapada.pastKarma: The soul was lazy in spiritual practice, dropped meditation in middle of journey, refused to share spiritual knowledge with a sincere seeker, or spoke against guru behind their back.
Uttara Bhadrapada.currentLife: Deep wisdom, calm presence, healing energy, writing ability, lucky in property and inheritance, devotion towards Shiva, capacity for solitude. But also tendency for isolation, deep loneliness, slow career start.
remedy: Meditate regularly without break for at least 11 minutes daily
Donate to spiritual organisations
Serve snake by offering milk on Naga Panchami
Feed poor on Saturday
Light lamp at Shiva temple on Saturday
Chant Rudram or Maha Mrityunjaya for one mandala
Uttara Bhadrapada.onceCleared: The soul becomes a quiet teacher of others naturally.

Revati.pastKarma: The soul harmed travellers, stole from pilgrims on the road, refused shelter to a lost soul who came for help, or misused position as a trusted guide.
Revati.currentLife: Kind heart, foreign connection, deep animal love, artistic mind, devotion towards Vishnu and Krishna, healing presence. But also pattern of being used by people, financial loss through helping the wrong person, and emotional drain.
remedy: Help travellers with food and direction
Support animal shelters through monthly donation
Donate shoes and warm cloth to needy
Feed fish in pond or river
Visit Krishna temple on Wednesday and Thursday
Chant Vishnu Sahasranama daily and Krishna mantra for 41 days
Revati.onceCleared: The kindness finally returns as real abundance and lasting respect.
